High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[DS-61-4 (Errata)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (A New Hope, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/DS-61-4 _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uPFHJcccd8UfhX-sP19RsnHqViuRjY2-/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>DS-61-4 _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,752 bytes, SHA-256 <code>a8523571341f98a1565456c6de846f19cfa2cea0732f359f3f43731fada0ea61</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This is a credited full-card fan rendition of the errata wording, retained as a qualified comparison on [[DS-61-4 (Errata)]]. It is not a scan of the original Glossary entry. The article uses its actual documentary excerpt as the primary illustration.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
